
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- triple_split.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- triple_split.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin a: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- triple_split.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin b: Output = 4
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin c: Output = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNREACHABLE -- triple_split.volt:10[/yellow bold]

Code after `every`/`on` block in task `triple` will never execute.

 [dim] 9 |[/dim]     every 100ms { a.toggle() }
 [dim]10 |[/dim]     every 200ms { b.toggle() }
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]          ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Move this code before the `every` block, or into a separate task.[/cyan]
